d: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Operations Manager to lead end-to-end manufacturing operations, project execution, production planning, warehouse management, inventory control, and plant development activities. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in beverage or FMCG manufacturing environments, with a proven track record in operational excellence, capital project delivery, production optimization, and team leadership.

This role is responsible for ensuring seamless operations from raw material planning through production and delivery while driving continuous improvement, plant expansion initiatives, and operational efficiency across the organization.
q: Minimum 15 years of experience in FMCG, beverage, or water manufacturing operations.
Proven experience in production plant management, maintenance, project management, and supply chain planning.
Hands-on exposure to installation and commissioning of beverage production lines.
Strong leadership, budgeting, resource planning, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel, and project management software.
GCC experience within the water or beverage manufacturing industry.
Experience with European production lines and plant expansion projects.
Join us to lead operational excellence, optimize manufacturing performance, and drive strategic growth across our production facilities.
r: Manage end-to-end plant operations, production planning, warehousing, and inventory control.
Drive plant expansion, machinery upgrades, and capital project execution.
Lead project planning, budgeting, contractor management, and ensure timely project delivery.
Coordinate procurement and production requirements based on sales forecasts.
Implement preventive maintenance programs to maximize plant efficiency and reliability.
Monitor operational KPIs, project cost variance (PCV), and project schedule variance (PSV).
Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
Develop teams, improve processes, and drive operational excellence initiatives.
